$comment: Generated from linking.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to linking.yaml>`. Do not edit.

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (ADR-0015). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

RelatedLink.description: One identifier as given, and what the adviser made of it.

scheme.description: The scheme it was recognised as, from schemes.yaml (doi, orcid, ror, grant), or unknown.

normalised.description: The identifier's canonical https form, for a DOI, ORCID iD or ROR id.

relation.description: A suggested DataCite relationType, such as IsSupplementTo, for the researcher to confirm. Absent where the mock cannot tell.

valid.description: Whether the identifier is well formed for its scheme. True does not mean it exists: nothing was resolved.

message.description: What the researcher should check or do with the identifier.

RelatedLink.title: RelatedLink

description: The payload of advisor.linking: each identifier recognised, checked for form and put in canonical form, with a suggested way to record it. It suggests linking metadata for the researcher to review; registering the links stays with the researcher and the repository (R11).

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

limitations.description: What this mock does not yet do.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

title: RelatedIdentifiers
